summary: Audience-segmentation feature, YouthWorx URL fix, and bad-jobs removal verified end-to-end. 10/10 backend pytest cases pass and all 10 frontend behaviours from the review request pass via Playwright on the live preview URL.

issues: Harmless 401s from /api/auth/me bootstrap on anonymous visits — same as iteration 2, browser network-layer log only, cannot be silenced from JS. Acceptable.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_programs/jobs/events use exact-match `filt['audiences'] = audience` — this works because Mongo matches a scalar against array elements. Behaviour is correct; no change needed.

Startup performs delete_many({slug:{$exists:false}}) on jobs/events every boot. Idempotent and intended for cleanup of legacy seeds, but worth a comment in the code that this is the explicit cleanup hook for future seeds.
audience.jsx default = 'youth' with try/catch around localStorage — safe. data-audience attribute set on <html> enables CSS theming hooks if ever needed.
